frozen_inputs.window_manifest: one deterministic manifest shared by every checkpoint and diagnostic

primary_measurements: loss and gradient norm by regime and parameter block
pairwise gradient cosine by regime and block
Hessian top eigenvalue with power-iteration residual

interpretation_rules.TR-01: event-targeted update share below 5% and event-gradient SNR remains usable
interpretation_rules.LO-04: stable median event-versus-slow or event-versus-synaptic gradient cosine below -0.10
interpretation_rules.LO-02: rarer target-voltage bins show larger errors while event gradients remain usable
interpretation_rules.DG-02: event-gradient SNR or event-to-natural gradient ratio is too weak, or DG-01 signatures disagree
interpretation_rules.OP-01: event gradients are strong and aligned but the checkpoint occupies a smooth failure basin

guardrails: no optimizer construction or parameter update
checkpoint and dataset hashes must agree
same validation manifest for all four cells
automatic branch scores require human review
DG-02 runs on the identical manifest before any training branch is authorized
